items.abstract: **Session must be added during registration in order to add to your schedule** CodeQL is a semantic analysis engine that ships with rules to discover vulnerabilities. Discover how we solved this issue at Air France KLM by implementing Infrastructure as state, thanks to GitHub Actions and a human-readable YAML contract.
